text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen. A while has passed since our setback at the Mainichi Okan, but El Condor Pasa is set to make an amazing comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa declares to Silence Suzuka that she'll beat her, even if she doesn't have what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Silence Suzuka quietly remarks that El Condor Pasa possesses a power that she herself does not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That said, she has no intention of losing. The clash between these two competitive souls… begin now!
